experian.reason: Safety: sign-in and bot-wall handoffs, Experian redirects, an explicit Chrome profile and route for every session, open, close, and finish_task with a process list over 1 MiB, the owner's Chrome keeping its active tab while the agent works in a background task tab, a Chrome copy that restores many tabs opening the agent's page in a new background tab beside them, one browser connection per Chrome user-data-dir, shared by every session through the hold, and the gated extension route closing only its own tabs.

video-host.reason: Safety: a host signal stops a pass-through session within its cap and the run still points at a playable video. Split from experian so each group stays well under the 4-minute job limit when a lockfile change misses the package cache.

isolation.reason: Safety: native permissions, the test guard for the owner's Chrome port, daily-profile refusal, signed helper identity, staged secret owner, and camera/microphone denial.

browser.reason: Safety: short snapshot find and diff results, the MCP viewer, the owner's Chrome keeping the agent in its task tab and out of Chrome's own panels, and the Replay switch hiding every replay entry in the app and bao mcp until it is on.

browser-mcp.reason: Safety: pass-through sessions through the MCP server and the agent-browser proxy. Split from browser so each group stays well under the 4-minute job limit when a lockfile change misses the package cache.

receipt.reason: Coverage: the run record and the receipt of a first agent run. Each command's sentence and stored step, uploads and downloads, step records and the HAR, the receipt outline and page, the trace view, get_run and the MCP cards, and who holds the tab during an owner wait.

core.reason: Coverage: the app shell, Runs rows and the run viewer, page classes, video privacy, and bounded test-runner safety cases.
